# Contributing

All pull requests must be meaningful and pass CI before they are accepted.

You may also find the following tools useful:

- [TypeScript AST Viewer](https://ts-ast-viewer.com/)
- [Using the Compiler API](https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/wiki/Using-the-Compiler-API)

If you're using the Biome VSCode extension, let me know if it crashes a lot too. I've been having quite a few problems with it lately.
